paragraphs.text: I have a little sister. Her name is Lily. She is four years old. She likes apples very much.
paragraphs.translation: 我有一个小妹妹。她叫莉莉。她四岁了。她非常喜欢苹果。

paragraphs.text: We go to the apple orchard. The apple trees are very tall. There are many red apples. Some apples are green too.
paragraphs.translation: 我们去苹果园。苹果树很高。那里有许多红苹果。有些苹果也是绿色的。

paragraphs.text: My father has a big basket. He can reach the high apples. I pick the low apples. Lily holds a small basket.
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸有一个大篮子。他够得到高处的苹果。我摘低处的苹果。莉莉拿着一个小篮子。

paragraphs.text: Lily finds a yellow apple. It is like the sun! She puts it in her basket. She smiles at me.
paragraphs.translation: 莉莉找到一个黄苹果。它就像太阳一样！她把它放进篮子里，冲我笑。

paragraphs.text: Our dog Max runs to us. He likes apples too. He eats a small red apple. He is very happy now.
paragraphs.translation: 我们的狗马克斯跑到我们身边。它也喜欢苹果。它吃了一个小红苹果。它现在很开心。

paragraphs.text: We go home with three baskets. My mother makes apple juice. Lily drinks two big cups. We are a happy family.
paragraphs.translation: 我们带着三篮苹果回家。妈妈做了苹果汁。莉莉喝了两大杯。我们是快乐的一家人。
